name: rosetta-show-ascii-table
code:
use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line

name(code: int) -> string =>
    case code
    when 32 then "Spc"
    when 127 then "Del"
    else "{cast char(code)}"
    esac

let columns = 6

for row in 0..16 do
    for column in 0..columns do
        if column > 0 then
            write("  ")
        fi

        let code = 32 + column * 16 + row
        let last = column == columns - 1
        let shown = if last then name(code) else "{name(code),-3}" fi

        write("{code,3} : {shown}")
    od

    write_line()
od
